night3_start.name: {name}
night3_start.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day.*

night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.text: What you saw today stays between us.

night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.text: *I stare at the message for a long while, then turn off the screen. The room gets a little darker.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.text: *She sent a photo of a note. A single line written in her notebook.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.text: That novel, I still haven’t decided on the ending

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.text: *The cursor blinks on the last line of the notepad. Leave the ending blank, and the file stays in saving mode.*

night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.text: if you wanna ask about my ankle, ask me in person lol

night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.text: *Long blank space after 'lol'. Dain's next message doesn't come.*

night3_dream_1.name: {name}
night3_dream_1.text: *I had a dream. Walking side by side with someone. I couldn't see their face, only footsteps keeping the same rhythm.*

night3_dream_2_b.name: {name}
night3_dream_2_b.text: *I closed the notepad. No sentence to send tomorrow yet. But I decided not to leave the screen blank.*

night3_faithful_reflect_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_1.text: *Open my eyes. Morning sunlight comes through the curtains. My palms are still warm. I took out my cell phone. Opened a gallery. Sojeong's photo. — Stopped scrolling, pressed and held*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.text: *'Delete this photo?' My finger hovers over the confirm button.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.text: *One second. Just staring at the screen. — Sojeong's desk graffiti. The thirty-eight mornings I looked away.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.text: *...okay. I put my finger on the delete button. — pressed.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3.text: *My finger stops over the delete button. Instead I moved the photo to a new folder. Folder name: 'Record'.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.text: *Minsu said. 'Rejection is also something you have to do.' Sojung in the gallery is still smiling. Notepad number 38 has not been sent yet. Only the send button is blue.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4.text: *The gallery is empty. The place where Sojung’s photo was. A blank screen is rather clear. I will tell you when I see it. I will come forward if I know.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_b.text: *Deleting the photo was easy. Just one finger. I stare at the empty album thumbnail for a while.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_c.text: *Covered the cell phone. An empty gallery space appears on a black screen.*

night3_dream_seo_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_seo_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the feeling of walking beside Seoyeon still lingers.*

night3_dream_yuna_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_yuna_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the quiet air beside Yuna still lingers.*

night3_dream_dain_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_dain_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, Dain's laughter comes back to me a beat later.*

night3_cheat_msg_1.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_1.text: *I’m back in my room. It was a heavy day. I look at my phone.*

night3_cheat_msg_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_2.text: Be that way only with me.

night3_cheat_msg_3_b.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_3_b.text: *She uses the word 'favor.' The cursor stays frozen after that word for a long time.*

night3_cheat_msg_5.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_5.text: *I just hope you don't treat that choice lightly.*

night3_cheat_msg_7.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_7.text: *She sent three lines. From someone who usually won't type even one.*

night3_nightmare_1.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_1.text: *I lie down with the lights off, but sleep won't come. Only my phone screen glows against my palm.*

night3_nightmare_2_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_2_b.text: *I open Seoyeon's chat. Her last message ends with, 'Please.'*

night3_nightmare_3.name: Seoyeon
night3_nightmare_3.text: I'm not asking you to answer now. Just don't avoid me tomorrow.

night3_nightmare_3_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_3_b.text: *In Yuna's chat, a read receipt sits beneath three lines of text.*

night3_nightmare_4.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4.text: *Her last sentence is short: 'Don't avoid me. That's all.'*

night3_nightmare_4_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4_b.text: *I open Dain's chat. Only one of her messages has a laugh attached to it.*

night3_nightmare_5.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_5.text: *'I wish it had been a joke.' There are no new messages after that.*

night3_nightmare_6.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_6.text: *I open and close all three chats in turn. In each text box, I type a different first letter, then erase it.*

night3_nightmare_choice.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_choice.text: *Who will I be honest with first tomorrow?*
choices: Decide to talk to Seoyeon first
Decide to talk to Yuna first
Decide to talk to Dain first

night3_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_seo.text: *In Seoyeon's text box, I write, 'I'll tell you face-to-face tomorrow.' My finger stops just before Send.*

night3_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_yuna.text: *In Yuna's text box, I write, 'I won't avoid you tomorrow. I'll tell you then.' My finger stops just before Send.*

night3_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_dain.text: *In Dain's text box, I write, 'I'm sorry I kept you waiting. I'll tell you tomorrow.' My finger stops just before Send.*

night3_nightmare_end.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end.text: *One sentence remains in one text box. I close the other two chats. Nothing has been sent yet.*

night3_nightmare_end_3.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end_3.text: *Three in the morning. I'm still awake. I close the messages and open my gallery. My finger stops on a photo of Sojeong.*

night3_cheat_reflect_2.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_2.text: *In the group photo, Sojeong is looking at the camera. Beside her, I'm looking somewhere else.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.text: *I close the photo and return to my messages. The sentence I wrote earlier is still saved as a draft.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.text: *I scan the list. A different last sentence remains beside each of the three names.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.text: *Minsu has replied, 'Putting it off won't make it disappear.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.text: *I read all three chats again from the top. I don't close any of them.*

night3_cheat_reflect_5.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_5.text: *I pull my hand away from Send and turn the phone face down. Three hours until my alarm.*
